# googleapis

Proto definitions copied verbatim from https://github.com/googleapis/googleapis
at commit `d2a3aec6cfed5b5065e1db1c6983deca6529ab79`, licensed under the
Apache License 2.0 (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)).

Only the files imported by the xAS protos are included:

- `google/api/field_behavior.proto`

The corresponding Go code is provided by the
`google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/api` module.
